*Situation Report/ Alternative Route*
Iyana Ipaja Roundabout inward Mosalasi roundabout on New Ipaja road is temporarily blocked by Police as a security measure in anticipation of the arrival of personalities envisaged to host a landmark event on Lion Field around Moshalasi corridor today.

All hands are on deck as our men are visible and on ground managing the effect on traffic on the available road inward Iyana Ipaja roundabout from Mosalasi.

*TRAFFIC ADVISORY:* Motorists are advised to avoid Iyana Ipaja roundabout, and Mosalasi roundabout for now and make use of Abeokuta Expressway, Egbeda Akowonjo, Agbotikuyo, Orelope Unity estate as alternative routes.
